integrity: The proof is analytic. Exact rational verification checks the standard-parameter center-manifold coefficients; finite numerical trajectories are not used as proof of the asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Local statement at rho=1 on a sufficiently smooth one-dimensional center manifold.
No uniform entrance-time or global-basin asymptotic is claimed.
Priority is assessed against the checked indexed and full-text literature; unpublished or unindexed derivations remain a residual risk.
title: First logarithmic correction to critical relaxation in the classical Lorenz system
